description: Permanently delete a hosted app — stops the container and removes its workspace, database, env vars, and subdomain. Irreversible (the GitHub repo is NOT touched). Confirm with the user before calling.
name: vibekit_delete_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Deletion confirmation for the app, its container, and its agent.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Delete App
